nodes.description: Public total token supply declared in ERC20Basic; set to initialSupply in the BNIToken constructor.
Mapping(address => uint256) of account balances declared in BasicToken; read and written by transfer and transferFrom.
Mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) allowance table declared in StandardToken; used by approve, allowance, transferFrom, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
Public owner address declared in Ownable; assigned from msg.sender and changed only by transferOwnership under onlyOwner.
Public token name string, hard coded to 'BNI' in BNIToken.
Public token symbol string, hard coded to 'BNI' in BNIToken.
Public decimals value set to 2 in BNIToken.
Private constant initial supply 10 * 10**(9+2) used to seed totalSupply and the owner balance.
Library function computing a * b and asserting a == 0 || c / a == b.
Library function computing a / b; Solidity reverts automatically on division by zero.
Library function asserting b <= a before returning a - b.
Library function computing a + b and asserting c >= a.
Public transfer(address,uint256): requires _to != 0 and _value <= balances[msg.sender], moves balances via SafeMath sub/add and emits Transfer.
Public constant balanceOf(address) returning balances[_owner].
Public transferFrom(address,address,uint256): validates _to, balance and allowance of msg.sender, then updates balances and allowed via SafeMath.
Public approve(address,uint256) that overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Public constant allowance(address,address) returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Public increaseApproval(address,uint) adding _addedValue to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] via SafeMath.add.
Public decreaseApproval(address,uint) that reads oldValue, zeroes the allowance if _subtractedValue > oldValue, otherwise uses SafeMath.sub.
Constructor of Ownable setting owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function transferOwnership(address) requiring newOwner != 0 and reassigning owner.
Constructor of BNIToken: sets owner = msg.sender, totalSupply = initialSupply and balances[owner] = initialSupply.
Caller address supplied by the transaction, used as balance/allowance key, as allowance owner, and as contract owner.
Multiplication a * b inside SafeMath.mul before the overflow assertion.
Division a / b inside SafeMath.div.
Subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub, guarded only by assert(b <= a).
Addition a + b inside SafeMath.add, guarded only by assert(c >= a).

edges.reason: transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and _to.
balanceOf returns balances[_owner].
transferFrom debits balances[_from] and credits balances[_to].
transferFrom checks and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance returns allowed[_owner][_spender].
increaseApproval increments allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval reads and rewrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
Ownable constructor assigns the owner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
BNIToken constructor sets totalSupply = initialSupply.
BNIToken constructor mints balances[owner] = initialSupply.
BNIToken constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
initialSupply constant seeds totalSupply and the owner balance in the constructor.
transfer uses msg.sender as the balance key for the value check and debit.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender].
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender.
increaseApproval keys the allowance on msg.sender.
decreaseApproval keys the allowance on msg.sender.
The Ownable constructor grants ownership to the untrusted msg.sender.
The onlyOwner check compares msg.sender with owner before transferring ownership.
BNIToken constructor makes the untrusted msg.sender the owner and the initial token holder.
Parameter a flows into the a * b multiplication.
Parameter b flows into the a * b multiplication.
Parameter a flows into the a / b division.
Parameter b is the divisor of the a / b division.
Parameter a flows into the a - b subtraction.
Parameter b flows into the a - b subtraction.
Parameter a flows into the a + b addition.
Parameter b flows into the a + b addition.
transfer uses SafeMath.sub on balances and on the checked value.
transfer uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on balances and the allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
increaseApproval uses SafeMath.add on the current allowance.
decreaseApproval uses SafeMath.sub on oldValue when it is large enough.
transfer recipient parameter feeds the address(0) check and the credit.
transfer amount parameter feeds the balance check and the SafeMath operations.
balanceOf account parameter indexes the balances mapping.
transferFrom source parameter feeds balance and allowance checks.
transferFrom destination parameter feeds the address(0) check and the credit.
transferFrom amount parameter feeds all validation and SafeMath calls.
approve spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
approve value parameter is written into the allowance slot.
allowance owner parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
allowance spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval added value flows into SafeMath.add.
decreaseApproval spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval subtracted value is compared with oldValue and passed to SafeMath.sub.
transferOwnership newOwner parameter is validated and assigned to owner.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into the owner state variable.
decreaseApproval copies the current allowance into the oldValue local variable.
oldValue is passed to SafeMath.sub to compute the reduced allowance.
SafeMath.mul executes the a * b multiplication.
SafeMath.div executes the a / b division.
SafeMath.sub executes the a - b subtraction.
SafeMath.add executes the a + b addition.
BNIToken constructor is invoked after the inherited Ownable constructor during deployment.
